role_in_op: Main objective (platoon) of op 4 and the FOB for op 6. The road town where the north causeway lands on Ember Crescent: the only vehicle road onto the crescent runs through it. The garrison holds the causeway gate, the square at the fork and the upper road toward the monastery; the fuel point 560 m west-south-west (4-07) and the AA 710 m north-east (4-08) support it.
approaches_text: Vehicles and infantry come up the causeway from the Cinder Cone (east-south-east). Boats land on the beach south of the town. From the west, the south-arm road (op 8's road) enters past the checkpoint 1 km away. The main street is the AI road: 8 m, gentle bends, no steep turns.
